MUS.note: Nothing on AI harm rules or an authority.
A national AI strategy is named only as context; no government AI system stated.
Nothing on AI in a sector's public system.
The portal is a training platform; no AI model, dataset or AI computing stated.
The hub is open to the public, students and professionals, not specific to civil servants.

facts.fact: On 6 November 2026 Mauritius launched the myt Learning Hub Portal, built by Mauritius Telecom with AWS, offering 16 free courses in AI, cloud, cybersecurity and data in support of the government's goal of training 50,000 Mauritians in a year; no number trained is given.
The government communique describes the launch as a step in implementing the national digital transformation strategy, the Digital Transformation Blueprint 2025-2029.
The Digital Transformation Blueprint is named as covering 2025-2029.
